name: ticker-universe-builder
description: Build and maintain evidence-gated ticker universes and grouped TradingView watchlists.

interface.longDescription: Build or maintain a grouped ticker universe for one market at a time. Covers fourteen reviewed markets and four depths: Light, Medium, Heavy and Max. The agent researches business leadership, economic coverage and sourced supplementary Beta; Python validates evidence contracts, selects members and writes TradingView TXT, readable Markdown, a complete offline HTML report, authoritative JSON and validation JSON. Max expands a qualified Heavy while preserving its theme proportions. Incomplete research is diagnosed and saved for continuation, with small count-only gaps explicitly disclosed as partial. Requires a host with Python 3.10+ and filesystem/command access; current builds also require online research and dated market data. Uses the Python standard library, without a hosted service or required API key. Examples are dated research replays. Produces an observation instrument, without return guarantees, portfolio allocations, order instructions or trade execution.
defaultPrompt: Build a US Medium ticker universe using current online evidence, with HTML, Markdown and TradingView exports.
Maintain my existing ticker universe and explain additions, removals and unresolved research.
Expand my qualified Heavy universe to Max with sourced Beta while preserving its theme distribution.

publication.release_notes: 0.9.2: compact installable skill ZIP, SHA-256 checksums, report previews and simpler installation; research inputs and selection rules unchanged.

zh-CN.subtitle: 构建可核验的标的观察池
zh-CN.description: 按行业与主题构建和维护标的观察池，覆盖十四个已审查市场及 Light、Medium、Heavy、Max 四个档位。Agent 研究主营、龙头与补充 Beta，Python 验证证据、保护基础覆盖并生成 TradingView TXT、Markdown、完整离线 HTML、JSON 和验证报告。Max 沿用 Heavy 的主题比例；证据不足会保留诊断和续跑记录。需 Python 3.10+、文件及命令访问能力，最新构建还需在线研究和有日期的市场数据。仅提供观察工具，不提供收益承诺、仓位配置或交易执行。
